description: Questions phrased the way customers ask them. 'expected_documents' lists every document that contains the answer. 'facts' are short strings a correct answer must contain (case-insensitive). Unanswerable questions have an empty expected_documents list: the right behaviour is to say the knowledge base doesn't cover it.
